safi-cedvel:59-60.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis (tawkīd); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (فيها) attached (mutaʿalliq) to the khabar (predicate) of lā; (الواو) a conjunction; (لكنّ ... لا يؤمنون) like ولكنّ ... لا يعلمون [Note: in verse (57) of this sūra].
Clause: «إنّ الساعة لآتية ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «لا ريب فيها ... » is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of (إنّ).
And the clause: «لكنّ أكثر ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause إنّ الساعة لآتية.
And the clause: «لا يؤمنون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of لكنّ.
(60) (الواو) a conjunction; (أستجب) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the apodosis of a command; (لكم) attached to (أستجب); (عن عبادتي) attached to (يستكبرون); (السين) a particle of futurity; (داخرين) an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
And the clause: «قال ربّكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause إنّ الساعة لآتية.
And the clause: «ادعوني ... » is in the position of accusative as the content of what was said (maqūl al-qawl).
And the clause: «أستجب لكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of an implied condition, not joined by fāʾ, i.e. "if you call upon Me, I will answer you".
And the clause: «إنّ الذين يستكبرون ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: or it is a causal clause for what precedes, since "calling upon" (duʿāʾ) is made to include the meaning of "worship" (ʿibāda)].
And the clause: «يستكبرون ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
And the clause: «سيدخلون ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.

* Rhetoric:
Figurative usage (majāz) and conformity (mushākala): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَقالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ».
It is a majāz mursal (loose figure) whose link is causality, because calling upon Allah (duʿāʾ) is the cause of worship. In the saying أستجب لكم there is mushākala (conformity), because the reward follows upon it. We have taken the speech as figurative because of the indication in His later words «إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبادَتِي», and this figure is supported by
the hadith of al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who said: «Supplication is worship»
and he recited this verse; and by the saying of Ibn ʿAbbās: The best worship is supplication.

safi-cedvel:61-63.t:
* I'rab:
(الذي) a relative noun in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) الله; (لكم) attached to an omitted second direct object (mafʿūl bihi), its implied form being "سكنا" [Note: this is shown by His saying: لتسكنوا]; (اللام) denotes purpose; (تسكنوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām ..., and the wāw is the agent (fāʿil); (فيه) attached to (تسكنوا).
And the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن تسكنوا..) is in the position of genitive through the lām, attached to (جعل).
(الواو) a conjunction; (النهار مبصرا) are two conjoined elements (maʿṭūfān) on the two preceding objects, respectively; (اللام) the shifted lām; the sign of the nominative in (ذو) is the wāw, since it is one of the five nouns; (على الناس) attached to فضل; (الواو) a conjunction; (لكنّ ... لا يشكرون) like ولكنّ.. لا يعلمون [Note: in verse (57) of this sūra].
Clause: «الله الذي ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «جعل ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
And the clause: «تسكنوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «إنّ الله لذو فضل ... » has no grammatical position; it has the force of a causal clause.
And the clause: «لكنّ أكثر ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause إنّ الله لذو ...
And the clause: «لا يشكرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of لكنّ.
(62) (الله، ربكم، خالق) three nominative khabars for the mubtadaʾ ذلكم; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (إلّا) for exception; (هو) a pronoun in the position of nominative, a badal (substitute) for the latent pronoun in the implied khabar, i.e. "there is no god existing except Him"; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition; (أنّى) an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverbial of place/manner, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the deputy agent (nāʾib fāʿil) in (تؤفكون) [Note: (أنّى) may be made to include the meaning of "how" (kayfa), in which case it is originally in the position of accusative as a ḥāl].
And the clause: «ذلكم الله ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «لا إله إلّا هو ... » is in the position of nominative as a fourth khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلكم).
And the clause: «تؤفكون ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if these are the attributes of Allah, then how are you turned away ...".
(63) (كذلك) attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the operator of which is (يؤفك); (الذين) a relative noun in the position of nominative as the deputy agent (nāʾib fāʿil); (بآيات) attached to (يجحدون).
And the clause: «يؤفك الذين ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «كانوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
And the clause: «يجحدون ... » is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا ...

* Rhetoric:
1- Figurative attribution (al-isnād al-majāzī): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «مُبْصِراً».
Seeing has been attributed to the day, although in reality seeing belongs to the people of the day.
The night is paired with the object of purpose (mafʿūl li-ajlihi) and the day with the ḥāl, because each of them performs the function of the other, and because, had it been said "that you may see in it" (لتبصروا فيه), the eloquence found in the figurative attribution would have been lost; and had it been said "still/calm" (ساكنا) — and the night may be described as calm in the literal sense, as in their expressions "a still night" (ليل ساج) and "a calm night with no wind in it" (ساكن لا ريح فيه) — the literal would not have been distinguished from the figurative.
2- Placing the overt noun in the place of the pronoun: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لا يَشْكُرُونَ». The context required him to say "but most of them" (ولكن أكثرهم), so that the mention of "people" would not be repeated; but in this repetition there is a specification of ingratitude for blessings as belonging to them, and that they are the ones who deny the favour of Allah and do not give thanks for it, like His sayings: «إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لَكَفُورٌ» «إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لِرَبِّهِ لَكَنُودٌ» «إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لَظَلُومٌ كَفَّارٌ».

safi-cedvel:64-65.t:
* I'rab:
(الله الذي ... بناء) the i'rab of its like has already been given [Note: in verse (61) of this sūra]; (الواو) a conjunction in both places, and likewise (الفاء) in both places; (من الطيّبات) attached to (رزقكم); (ذلكم الله ربّكم) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (62) of this sūra].
Clause: «الله الذي ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «جعل ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
And the clause: «صوّركم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
And the clause: «أحسن ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause صوّركم.
And the clause: «رزقكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause جعل.
And the clause: «ذلكم الله ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «تبارك الله ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause ذلكم الله.
(65) - (لا إله إلّا هو) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (62) of this sūra]; (الفاء) a conjunction, linking the effect to the cause; (مخلصين) an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent (fāʿil) of ادعوه; (له) attached to a ḥāl of (الدين), which is the object of the active participle مخلصين; (لله) attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) الحمد ...
And the clause: «هو الحيّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «لا إله إلّا هو ... » is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو).
And the clause: «ادعوه ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive clause.
And the clause: «الحمد لله ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive [Note: or it is in the position of accusative as the content of what was said (maqūl al-qawl) for an omitted "saying", itself in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the agent of ادعوه, i.e. "call upon Him ... saying: Praise be to Allah"].

* Morphology:
(صوركم): the plural of صورة, a noun for the shape or form of a human being or other; its wazn (pattern) is فعلة with ḍamma followed by sukūn.

safi-cedvel:66-66.t:
* I'rab:
(من دون) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted returning pronoun; (لمّا) an adverbial meaning "when" (ḥīna), including the meaning of a condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis [Note: it may be devoid of conditional sense, in which case it is attached to (نهيت)]; and (النون) in (جاءني) is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya); (من ربّي) attached to a ḥāl of البيّنات.
And the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن أعبد) is in the position of genitive through an omitted preposition, attached to (نهيت), i.e. "I have been forbidden from worshipping those whom you call upon".
(لربّ) attached to (أسلم).. and the interpreted maṣdar (أن أسلم) is in the position of accusative as a direct object (mafʿūl bihi), its operator being أمرت.
Clause: «قل ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «إنّي نهيت ... » is in the position of accusative as the content of what was said (maqūl al-qawl).
And the clause: «نهيت..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
And the clause: «أعبد ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «تدعون ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
And the clause: «جاءني البيّنات ... » is in the position of genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi ...
And the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by what precedes ...
And the clause: «أمرت ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause نهيت.
And the clause: «أسلم ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second particle-type relative (أن).

safi-cedvel:67-67.t:
* I'rab:
(من تراب) attached to (خلقكم) with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "He created your father"; (ثمّ) a conjunction in the five places; (من نطفة) attached to what (من تراب) is attached to, being conjoined to it, and likewise (من علقة); (طفلا) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of the addressee; (اللام) denotes purpose; (تبلغوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, and likewise (تكونوا) ...
And the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن تبلغوا....) is in the position of genitive through the lām, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "He keeps you alive".
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن تكونوا ... ) is in the position of genitive through the lām, attached to the omitted verb, being conjoined to the first maṣdar.
(الواو) a conjunction; (منكم) attached to a fronted khabar (predicate) of the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) (من); (قبل) an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of genitive through (من), attached to (يتوفّى); (الواو) a conjunction; (لتبلغوا) like the first; (الواو) a conjunction ...
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن تبلغوا ... ) is in the position of genitive, conjoined to an implied purpose clause, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "He did that", i.e. "He did that so that you might live, and so that you might reach ...".
Clause: «هو الذي ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «خلقكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
And the clause: «يخرجكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
And the clause: «تبلغوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «تكونوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second implied particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «منكم من ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause خلقكم.
And the clause: «تبلغوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the third implied particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «تبلغوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the third implied particle-type relative (أن). [Translator's note: the source repeats this line verbatim.]
And the clause: «لعلّكم تعقلون» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to an implied new purpose clause, i.e. "so that you may know that, and so that you may reason".
And the clause: «تعقلون ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.

safi-cedvel:68-68.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) a conjunction, and the second is the connector of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إنّما) kāffa (restraining) and makfūfa (restrained); (له) attached to (يقول); (الفاء) a conjunction.
Clause: «هو الذي ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «يحيي ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
And the clause: «يميت ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause يحيي.
And the clause: «قضى ... » is in the position of genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «يقول ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «كن ... » is in the position of accusative as the content of what was said (maqūl al-qawl).
And the clause: «يكون..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو" ...
And the nominal clause has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause إنّما يقول ...

safi-cedvel:38-44.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (يا قوم) its i'rab has been given [Note: in verse (29) of this sūra.] And (النون) in (اتّبعون) is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya). (أهدكم) is an imperfect verb in the jussive, the apodosis (jawāb) of a request. (سبيل) is a second direct object (mafʿūl bihi), accusative.
The clause «قال الذي....» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «آمن ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
And the vocative clause together with its response ... is in the position of accusative, being the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
And the clause «اتّبعون....» has no grammatical position; it is the response to the vocative.
And the clause «أهدكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of an implied condition not joined by (الفاء), i.e.: "if you follow me, I will guide you ...".
(39) (إنّما) is a restrictive particle and the restricted (kāffa and makfūfa). (الحياة) is a badal (substitute) for the demonstrative, the mubtadaʾ (subject) — or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it — nominative. (هي) is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: or a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is دار, the nominal clause being the khabar of inna.] And the vocative clause «يا قوم ... » has no grammatical position; a resumption within the sphere of the saying.
And the clause «هذه الحياة ... » has no grammatical position; it is the response to the vocative.
And the clause «إنّ الآخرة.. دار القرار» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the response to the vocative.
(40) (من) is a conditional noun that jazzes (the jussive), a mubtadaʾ. (الفاء) is the connective of the apodosis. (لا) is negative, and the deputy agent (nāʾib fāʿil) of (يجزى) is a pronoun referring to من. (إلّا) is for restriction. (مثلها) is a direct object, accusative. (الواو) is a conjunction. (من عمل صالحا) is like «من عمل سيّئة». (من ذكر) is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of عمل. (الواو) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (الفاء) is the connective of the apodosis. (فيها) is attached to (يرزقون) [Note: or attached to a ḥāl from the deputy agent.]. (بغير) is attached to a ḥāl from the deputy agent [Note: or to a ḥāl from the implied object.].
And the clause «من عمل ... » has no grammatical position; a resumption within the sphere of the response to the vocative.
And the clause «عمل سيّئة ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is permissible that the khabar be the protasis and the apodosis clauses together, in the two conjoined conditions.].
And the clause «لا يجزى ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو" ... and the nominal clause is in the position of jussive, the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.
And the clause «من عمل (the second)» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the first clause (من عمل).
And the clause «هو مؤمن ... » is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl.
And the clause «أولئك يدخلون ... » is in the position of jussive, the apodosis of the second condition, joined with the fāʾ.
And the clause «يدخلون ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
And the clause «يرزقون ... » is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl from the agent of يدخلون.
(41) (الواو) is a conjunction. (ما) is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative, a mubtadaʾ. (لي) is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. (إلى النجاة) is attached to (أدعو). (إلى النار) is attached to (تدعونني).
And the clause «يا قوم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the preceding clause "O my people".
And the clause «مالي ... » has no grammatical position; it is the response to the vocative.
And the clause «أدعوكم ... » is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl from the pronoun in (لي).
And the clause «تدعونني ... » is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl from an implied element, i.e. "and what is the matter with you that you call me", and the implied clause is conjoined to the clause «مالي ...».
(اللام) is the lām of cause. (أكفر) is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the lām. (بالله) is attached to (أكفر). (أشرك) is an imperfect verb in the accusative, conjoined to (أكفر). (به) is attached to (أشرك). (ما) is a relative noun [Note: or an indefinite noun qualified by a description, in the position of accusative, the clause after it being its adjective.] in the position of accusative, a direct object. (لي) is attached to the khabar of ليس. (به) is attached to (علم), which is the postponed noun of ليس. (الواو) is a conjunction. (إلى العزيز) is attached to (أدعوكم).
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن أكفر ... ) is in the position of genitive by the (اللام), attached to (تدعونني).
And the clause «تدعونني (the second)» is in the position of accusative, a badal (substitute) for the clause تدعونني (the first).
And the clause «أكفر ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type relative (أن), which is implied.
And the clause «أشرك ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause أكفر.
And the clause «ليس لي به علم..» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما).
And the clause «أنا أدعوكم ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause تدعونني [Note: It is permissible for the clause to be a ḥāl from the object of تدعونني.].
And the clause «أدعوكم ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنا).
(43) (لا) is the lā of generic negation. (جرم) is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative, the ism of lā [Note: See further clarification and detail in the analyses of (لا جرم) in verse (22) of Sūrat Hūd and verse (23) of Sūrat al-Naḥl.]. (ما) is a relative in the position of accusative, the ism of anna [Note: (أنّما) is written joined in the muṣḥaf, though its due is to be written separately.]. And the second (النون) in (تدعونني) is the nūn of protection. (إليه) is attached to (تدعونني). (له) is attached to the khabar of ليس. (دعوة) is the postponed ism of ليس, nominative. (في الدنيا) is attached to دعوة. (الواو) is a conjunction. (لا) is redundant (zāʾida), for emphasis of the negation. (في الآخرة) is attached to what (في الدنيا) is attached to, and so is conjoined to it. (الواو) is a conjunction. (إلى الله) is attached to the khabar of anna. (هم) is a pronoun of separation [Note: or a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is أصحاب.. and the nominal clause is the khabar of anna.].
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّما تدعونني..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted (في), attached to an omitted element that is the khabar of لا [Note: and in the other analyses it is the agent of (جرم), with lā redundant, or the agent of (لا جرم) — as a single word — in the sense of "it is right".].
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّ مردنا إلى الله) is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar.
And the clause «لا جرم ... » has no grammatical position; a resumption within the sphere of the response to the vocative.
And the clause «تدعونني ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما).
And the clause «ليس له دعوة ... in the position of nominative, the khabar of anna.»
(44) (الفاء) is the connective of an implied condition. (السين) is a particle of futurity. (ما) is a relative noun in the position of accusative, a direct object [Note: or a maṣdar particle.. and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative, with no omission of the returning pronoun.]. (لكم) is attached to (أقول). (الواو) is a conjunction. (إلى الله) is attached to (أفوّض). (بالعباد) is attached to بصير.
And the clause «ستذكرون ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "when you witness the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, you will remember what I say ...".
And the clause «أقول ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما), the returning pronoun being omitted.
And the clause «أفوض ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause ستذكرون.
And the clause «إنّ الله بصير ... » has no grammatical position; explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(38) أهدكم: it has an omission-weakening (iʿlāl by deletion) for the sake of the jussive; its origin is أهديكم, and its wazn is أفعكم.
(41) النجاة: an auditory (samāʿī) verbal noun of the verb نجا, of the Naṣara bāb; its wazn is فعلة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ and lām and the ʿayn with sukūn. It has a weakening by substitution (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb): its origin is نجوة with fatḥa on the wāw; the vowel of the wāw was moved to the jīm — a weakening by sukūn — and then the wāw was turned into an alif with a fatḥa before it. There are also other verbal nouns of the verb: نجاء, with the wāw turned into a hamza, on the wazn فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ; نجو on the wazn فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; and نجاية.

* Rhetoric:
Repetition (takrīr): in addressing his people with his words «يا قَوْمِ».
He repeated the address to them in order to rouse them from the sleep of heedlessness, out of concern for the one addressed, and as an intensification in rebuking them for how they met his call. And he left out the conjunction in the second address, which is «يا قَوْمِ إِنَّما هذِهِ الْحَياةُ الدُّنْيا», because it is an explanation of what was stated in summary in the address before it, namely the guidance to the path of right conduct; for that is the warning against clinging to this world and the encouragement to prefer the Hereafter over the first life.

safi-cedvel:45-46.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive. (ما) is a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of genitive, the returning pronoun being omitted.]. (بآل) is attached to (حاق)..
And the interpreted maṣdar (ما مكروا..) is in the position of genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «وقاه الله ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «مكروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type relative (ما).
And the clause «حاق ... سوء ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause وقاه الله.
(46) (النار) is a mubtadaʾ, nominative [Note: or a badal (substitute) for سوء العذاب, the clause after it being a ḥāl; or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the clause after it being a ḥāl as well.]. And the wāw in (يعرضون) is the deputy agent. (عليها) is attached to (يعرضون). (غدوا) is an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يعرضون). (يوم) is an adverb of time, accusative, attached to an implied verb, its implied form being "Allah says ...". (أشدّ) is a second direct object, accusative, because أدخلوا is made to include the meaning of أذيقوا..
And the clause «النار يعرضون عليها ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: or it is a badal (substitute) for سوء العذاب, in the position of nominative.].
And the clause «يعرضون ... » is in the position of nominative [Translator's note: the source reads "رفع جرّ" (nominative, genitive); the intended reading is evidently "nominative", the khabar of the mubtadaʾ النار], the khabar of the mubtadaʾ النار.
And the clause «تقوم الساعة ... » is in the position of genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause «أدخلوا ... » is in the position of accusative, the content of an implied saying, i.e. "Allah says to the angels: Enter ...".

safi-cedvel:47-47.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (إذ) is an adverbial noun in the position of accusative, a direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember) [Note: Abū l-Baqāʾ allowed it to be conjoined to the adverb (غدوا), attached to what ... is attached to.]. (في النار) is attached to a ḥāl from the agent of (يتحاجّون). (الفاء) is a conjunction. (للذين) is attached to (يقول). (إنّا) is a particle likened to the verb (inna), with its ism. (لكم) is attached to (تبعا). (الفاء) is a conjunction. (هل) is an interrogative particle. (عنّا) is attached to (مغنون). (نصيبا) is a direct object of the active participle مغنون, by making it include the meaning of "bearers" (حاملون) [Note: or an absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq) standing in for the maṣdar, an adjective of it, its governor being مغنون, i.e. "averting from us an aversion, a share of the Fire"; Abū l-Baqāʾ mentioned it.]. (من النار) is attached to an adjective of (نصيبا).
The clause « (اذكر) إذ يتحاجّون ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «يتحاجّون ... » is in the position of genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause «يقول الضعفاء» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause يتحاجّون.
And the clause «استكبروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause «إنّا كنّا ... » is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «كنّا لكم تبعا» is in the position of nominative, the khabar of inna.
And the clause «هل أنتم مغنون ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause إنّا كنّا..

safi-cedvel:1-3.t:
* I'rab:
(تنزيل) mubtadaʾ, nominative «[Note: or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هذا".]». (من الله) attached to an omitted element, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. (غافر) third adjective of the Name of Majesty (Allah), genitive. (شديد) badal (substitute) for the Name of Majesty «[Note: because the annexation in the assimilated adjective (al-ṣifa al-mushabbaha) is not pure but verbal (lafẓiyya), that is, "severe in His punishment", so شديد is not entirely definite.]», genitive. (ذي) adjective of the Name of Majesty, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ. (لا) of generic negation. (إلّا) for exception. (هو) detached pronoun in the position of the nominative, a badal for the latent pronoun in the omitted khabar. (إليه) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (المصير).
Clause: «تنزيل الكتاب من الله....» has no grammatical position; inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya).
And the clause: «لا إله إلّا هو....» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «إليه المصير» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(غافر): the word is an active participle from the triliteral (غفر); its wazn is فاعل, and its meaning is an assimilated adjective, since it indicates permanence.
(قابل): like غافر.
(التوب): a samāʿī (heard-from-the-Arabs) maṣdar of the verb تاب يتوب, of the bāb of قال, meaning returning from sin; likewise توبة, on the wazn فعل with fatḥa on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.. al-Akhfash said it is the plural of توبة.

safi-cedvel:4-5.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) negation. (في آيات) attached to (يجادل). (إلّا) for restriction. (الذين) relative noun in the position of the nominative; agent. (الفاء) to connect the effect with the cause. (لا) prohibitive, jussive. (في البلاد) attached to تقلّبهم.
Clause: «ما يجادل.. إلّا الذين..» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause: «لا يغررك تقلّبهم..» has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. "Be aware, so let their going about not deceive you.." «[Note: It is permissible that the clause be in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "If those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah are disbelievers, then let their going about not deceive you.. for they will soon be seized for their disbelief as those before them were seized."]».
(5) (قبلهم) adverb of time, accusative, attached to (كذّبت). (من بعدهم) attached to a ḥāl from الأحزاب. (الواو) conjunction in both places. (برسولهم) attached to (همّت). (اللام) of causation. (يأخذوه) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām.
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن يأخذوه) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (همّت).
(بالباطل) attached to (جادلوا). (ليدحضوا) like ليأخذوه.. and the preposition and its noun are attached to (جادلوا). (به) attached to (يدحضوا). (الفاء) conjunction, and the second resumptive. (كيف) interrogative noun in the position of the accusative; khabar of كان. (عقاب) ism (subject) of كان, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied ḍamma on the letter before the omitted first-person yāʾ, omitted to suit the verse ending (fāṣila).. and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «كذّبت.. قوم» has no grammatical position; causal.
And the clause: «همّت كلّ..» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause كذّبت.. قوم.
And the clause: «يأخذوه ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
And the clause: «جادلوا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause كذّبت.
And the clause: «يدحضوا ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
And the clause: «أخذتهم..» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause كذّبت.
And the clause: «كان عقاب ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive «[Note: It is permissible that it be the answer to an implied condition, i.e. "When I punished them, my punishment was just", or it falls in its proper place and the interrogative is for affirmation (taqrīr).]».

* Benefits:
- Disputation concerning the verses of the Qur'an:
This verse indicates the disbelief of those who deny the verses of Allah the Mighty and Majestic and do not submit to the rulings in them, but try to refute them, nullify them and object to them.
On the authority of Abū Hurayra, may Allah be pleased with him, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: "Disputation in the Qur'an is disbelief." Narrated by Abū Dāwūd.
On the authority of ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard people disputing, and he said: "It was only by this that those before you were destroyed. They struck parts of the Book of Allah the Mighty and Majestic against other parts. But the Book was revealed so that parts of it confirm other parts, so do not deny some of it by means of other parts. What you know of it, say it; and what you do not know of it, refer it to the one who knows it."

safi-cedvel:6-6.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (كذلك) attached to an omitted absolute (muṭlaq) element, whose governing verb is حقّت. (على الذين) attached to (حقّت).
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم أصحاب ... ) is in the position of the nominative, a badal for (كلمة) ربّك.. an inclusive substitute (badal ishtimāl) in terms of meaning, or a total substitute (badal kull) in terms of wording.
Clause: «حقّت كلمة ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (الذين).

safi-cedvel:7-9.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction in the five places. (من) relative noun in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the mubtadaʾ (الذين). (حوله) adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted element, the ṣila of من. (بحمد) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of يسبّحون. (به) attached to (يؤمنون). (للذين) attached to (يستغفرون). (ربّنا) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative. (رحمة) tamyīz (specification) transposed from the agent. (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition. (للذين) attached to (اغفر). (عذاب) second direct object, accusative.
Clause: «الذين يحملون ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «يحملون ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause: «يسبّحون ... » in the position of the nominative; khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
And the clause: «يؤمنون به ... » in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يسبّحون.
And the clause: «يستغفرون ... » in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يسبحون.
And the clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
And the vocative clause and its response ... are in the position of the accusative; maqūl al-qawl of an implied saying..
And the implied saying clause is in the position of the accusative; ḥāl from the agent of يستغفرون, i.e.: "saying: Our Lord, You encompass ..."
And the clause: «وسعت ... » has no grammatical position; the response to the vocative.
And the clause: «اغفر ... » in the position of the jussive; apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if Your mercy encompasses everything, then forgive those who repented ..."
And the clause: «تابوا ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the third relative (الذين).
And the clause: «اتّبعوا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the ṣila clause.
And the clause: «قهم..» conjoined to the clause اغفر ...
(8) (الواو) conjunction in the four places. (ربّنا) like the first. (التي) relative noun in the position of the accusative; adjective of جنّات. (من) relative noun in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the pronoun that is the object in (أدخلهم or وعدتهم). (من آبائهم) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of صلح. (أنت) detached pronoun in the position of the nominative; mubtadaʾ «[Note: or in the position of the accusative, borrowed for emphasis of the attached pronoun that is the ism of إنّ]», its khabar being (العزيز).
And the vocative clause.. has no grammatical position; parenthetical, for the sake of seeking mercy.
And the clause: «أدخلهم ... » in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the clause اغفر ...
And the clause: «وعدتهم..» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (التي).
And the clause: «صلح».. has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (من).
And the clause: «إنّك أنت العزيز ... » has no grammatical position; giving the reason for the seeking of mercy.
And the clause: «أنت العزيز ... » in the position of the nominative; khabar of إنّ.
(9) (الواو) conjunction, and the second resumptive. (من) conditional noun that jazms, in the position of the accusative as a direct object, its governing verb being تق. (يومئذ) adverb of time, accusative, annexed to another adverb, attached to (تق); the tanwīn in it is a substitute for an omitted clause «[Note: that is, "the day when You admit whom You will to Paradise or the Fire"]». (الفاء) connecting the apodosis. (قد) particle of certainty. (الواو) resumptive. (هو) pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: or a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ, its khabar being الفوز, the nominal clause being the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك.]».
And the clause: «قهم ... (the second)» in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the clause اغفر.
And the clause: «تق ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «رحمته ... » in the position of the jussive; apodosis of the condition, accompanied by the fāʾ.
And the clause: «ذلك ... الفوز» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(تق): it contains an ʿilāl (weak-letter change) by deletion to suit the jussive, its origin being تقي; and another ʿilāl by deletion because it is the imperfect of a verb weak in its fāʾ, whose fāʾ is dropped in the imperfect, its past being وقى.. its wazn is تع, with its fāʾ and lām dropped.

* Rhetoric:
Al-isjāl after al-mughālaṭa (the registering after the sophistical move): in His saying, the Exalted: «رَبَّنا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدْتَهُمْ».
This is an elegant art among the arts of rhetoric, called "al-isjāl after al-mughālaṭa": the speaker intends an aim concerning someone praised, and so brings words that establish that he has reached that aim, as a registration (isjāl) of it for the one praised. The explanation is that he stipulates a condition whose occurrence necessitates the occurrence of that aim, then reports its occurrence by way of sophistry (mughālaṭa); and sometimes the isjāl occurs without mughālaṭa. This is the type that occurs in the Noble Book.

* Benefits:
- The bearers of the Throne:
It was said: they are four of the angels, among the noblest and most excellent of the angels because of their nearness to Allah the Mighty and Majestic. It is reported in the ḥadīth that they have no speech other than glorification (tasbīḥ), praise (taḥmīd) and exaltation (tamjīd); the distance from their hooves to their knees is like that from one heaven to another. Ibn ʿAbbās said:
the bearers of the Throne: the distance from the ankle of one of them to the sole of his feet is a journey of five hundred years.
Jābir narrated from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: "I have been permitted to speak of one of the angels of Allah the Mighty and Majestic, of the bearers of the Throne: the distance between the lobe of his ear and his shoulder is a journey of seven hundred years."
Narrated by Abū Dāwūd.

safi-cedvel:10-10.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) in (ينادون) deputy agent. (اللام) the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ), for emphasis. (من مقتكم) attached to أكبر. (أنفسكم) direct object of the maṣdar مقتكم. (إذ) adverb of past time in the position of the accusative, attached to the first (مقت) «[Note: that is, Allah's hating you in the world, when you were called to faith and disbelieved, is greater than your hating yourselves now while you are in the Fire.. and there is no objection to the khabar standing between the mubtadaʾ and the adverb.]». (تدعون) like ينادون. (إلى الإيمان) attached to (تدعون). (الفاء) conjunction.
Clause: «إنّ الذين كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause: «ينادون ... » in the position of the nominative; khabar of إنّ.
And the clause: «لمقت الله أكبر ... » has no grammatical position; an explanation of the calling «[Note: or it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).]».
And the clause: «تدعون ... » in the position of the genitive; muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «تكفرون» in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause تدعون.

* Morphology:
(ينادون): it contains an ʿilāl by deletion; its origin is يناداون, with an alif after the dāl; two sākin letters met, the alif and the wāw, so the alif was dropped, and what precedes it remained with fatḥa as an indication of it; its wazn is يفاعون with fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(تدعون): it takes the same ruling as ينادون in the ʿilāl; both are weak in the lām and passive.

safi-cedvel:48-48.t:
* I'rab:
(كلّ) is a mubtadaʾ, nominative [Note: it indicates generality, and it is in the intention of annexation (iḍāfa), i.e. "every group of us", the tanwīn in it being a compensation for this omitted element ...]. (فيها) is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ كلّ. (قد) is a particle of confirmation. (بين) is an adverb, accusative, attached to (حكم).
The clause «قال الذين ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «استكبروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause «إنّا كلّ فيها ... » is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «كلّ فيها ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of inna.
And the clause «إنّ الله قد حكم ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
And the clause «قد حكم ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of inna.

* Benefits:
- A question and a disagreement:
A disagreement arose among the grammarians over the i'rab of (كلا) in the reading of the one who read (إنا كلّا فيها), although the well-known reading is the nominative. As for the nominative reading, there is no difficulty in it; al-Akhfash said: كلّ is nominative as a mubtadaʾ. Al-Kisāʾī and al-Farrāʾ allowed (إنا كلا فيها) with the accusative, as an adjective (naʿt) and emphasis (tawkīd) of the pronoun in (إنا). Ibn al-Samayqaʿ and ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar also read it so. The Kufans call tawkīd a naʿt. Sībawayh forbade that, saying: because كلّا is neither described nor used to describe, and a badal (substitute) is not permissible in it, since the one who speaks of himself has nothing else substituted for him. Al-Mubarrad said the same in meaning, saying: it is not permissible to substitute for the pronoun here because it is a first-person speaker (mukhāṭab) [Translator's note: the source text reads "mukhāṭab" (addressee) here; it is translated as written], and a substitute is not made for the speaker or for the addressee, because they are not ambiguous so that a substitute should be made for them.
Al-Farrāʾ and al-Zamakhsharī allowed that «كل», used as emphasis, be cut off from annexation in wording, holding to the reading of some of them (إنا كلا فيها). Ibn Mālik analysed it as كلا being a ḥāl from the pronoun of the adverbial phrase, and there is weakness in this on two counts: the placing of the ḥāl before its governor, the adverbial phrase, and the cutting off of «كل» from annexation in wording and in implication so that it becomes indefinite and thus can be a ḥāl. The better course is to take «كلا» as a badal (substitute) for the ism of inna; the substitution of an overt noun for a first-person pronoun is permitted, as a badal of the whole (badal kull), because it conveys comprehensiveness, as in: «قمت ثلاثتكم» ("you three, all of you, I stood"); and a badal of the whole needs no pronoun. And «كل» may directly follow governors when it is not attached to a pronoun, as in (جاءني كل القوم), so its occurring as a badal is permissible, unlike «جاءني كلهم», which is not permissible except out of necessity. This is the best of what has been said about this reading.

safi-cedvel:49-49.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive — or a conjunction. (في النار) is attached to an omitted element that is the ṣila of the relative الذين. (لخزنة) is attached to (قال). (يخفّف) is an imperfect verb in the jussive, the apodosis of a request, and the agent is "he". (عنّا) is attached to (يخفّف), accusative [Translator's note: the source says "accusative" for a prepositional phrase; translated as written]. (من العذاب) is attached to (يخفّف) [Note: it is permissible that the prepositional phrase be an adjective of the omitted object, with (من) partitive.], and its object is omitted, i.e. "something".
The clause «قال الذين ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive [Note: or conjoined to the clause «قال الذين» in the preceding verse.].
And the clause «ادعوا ... » is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «يخفّف ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of an implied condition not joined with the fāʾ, i.e.: "if you call upon your Lord, He will lighten ...".

* Rhetoric:
Putting the overt noun in place of the pronoun: in the words of the Exalted «لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ».
He put Jahannam in place of the pronoun, for the sake of intensifying terror and horror, or to show their place within it, in that Jahannam is the deepest of the levels of the Fire and in it are the disbelievers, or because the angels charged with the punishment of its people are better able to intercede, owing to their greater nearness to Allah the Exalted.

safi-cedvel:50-50.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) is for rebuking interrogation. (الواو) is a conjunction. (تك) is an imperfect verb, jussive, defective (nāqiṣ), the sign of the jussive being the overt sukūn on the nūn, which was omitted for lightness; its ism is a pronoun obligatorily latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هم" (they), referring to رسلكم, and there is a dispute over governance (tanāzuʿ) in it; and (رسلكم) is the agent of تأتيكم, nominative. (بالبيّنات) is attached to a ḥāl from رسلكم. (بلى) is a particle of response, the matter responded to being omitted, i.e.: "they came to us and we denied them". (الفاء) is the connective of an implied condition. (الواو) is resumptive. (ما) is negative, not operating. (إلّا) is for restriction. (في ضلال) is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ دعاء.
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
And the clause «لم تك تأتيكم ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the implied content of the saying, i.e. "Did your messengers not leave you, and did they not come to you ...".
And the clause «تأتيكم رسلكم ... » is in the position of accusative, the khabar of تك.
And the clause «قالوا ... (the second)» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «بلى and the matter responded to ... » is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «قالوا (the third)» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «ادعوا ... » is in the position of jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you want to supplicate, then supplicate ...". And the clause of the condition and its apodosis is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «ما دعاء الكافرين إلّا في ضلال» has no grammatical position; resumptive [Note: it is possible that it is from the speech of Allah the Exalted to His Prophet, and possible that it is from the speech of the keepers.].

safi-cedvel:51-52.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis. (الواو) is a conjunction in both places. (الذين) is a relative in the position of accusative, conjoined to رسلنا. (في الحياة) is attached to (ننصر). (يوم) is an adverb of time, accusative, attached to an omitted verb indicated by the one mentioned, i.e. "and We will help them on the day when ... arise".
The clause «إنّا لننصر ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «ننصر ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of inna.
And the clause «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause «يقوم الأشهاد» is in the position of genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi.
(52) (يوم) is a badal (substitute) for the preceding يوم, accusative. (لا) is negative. (الواو) is a conjunction. (لهم) is attached to a fronted khabar for the mubtadaʾ (اللعنة), and likewise the second (لهم)..
And the clause «لا ينفع.. معذرتهم» is in the position of genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause «لهم اللعنة ... » is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause لا ينفع..
And the clause «لهم سوء ... » is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause لهم اللعنة.

safi-cedvel:11-12.t:
* I'rab:
(ربّنا) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative. (اثنتين) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the verbal noun, and so it is its adjective, in both places; the governing verb of the first is أمتنا and of the second أحييتنا. (الفاء) conjunction. (بذنوبنا) attached to (اعترفنا). (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition. (هل) interrogative particle. (إلى خروج) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (سبيل), which is genitive in form and nominative in position.
Clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «ربّنا ... » in the position of the accusative; maqūl al-qawl.
And the clause: «أمتّنا ... » has no grammatical position; the response to the vocative.
And the clause: «أحييتنا..» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أمتنا.
And the clause: «اعترفنا..» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أمتنا.
And the clause: «هل إلى خروج من سبيل» in the position of the jussive; apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if our confession of our sins is accepted, then will we get out of the Fire ..."
(12) (ذلكم) mubtadaʾ. (الله) the Name of Majesty, deputy agent. (وحده) ḥāl, accusative, from the Name of Majesty..
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّه إذا دعي ... ) is in the position of the genitive by (الباء), attached to an omitted element, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلكم.
And the deputy agent of the verb (يشرك) is omitted, indicated by the context, i.e. "a partner". (به) attached to (يشرك). (الفاء) resumptive. (لله) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الحكم)..
And the clause: «ذلكم بأنّه ... » has no grammatical position; giving a reason for something implied, i.e. "No, there is no exit from the Fire, because of your disbelief."
And the conditional clause with إذا, its verb and its apodosis, is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of أنّ.
And the clause: «دعي الله ... » in the position of the genitive; muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «كفرتم ... » has no grammatical position; apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «إن يشرك به ... » in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause that is the khabar of أنّ.
And the clause: «تؤمنوا ... » has no grammatical position; apodosis of the condition, not accompanied by the fāʾ.
And the clause: «الحكم لله ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive «[Note: or in the position of the jussive, apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if the reckoning comes, then the judgement belongs to Allah."]».

* Rhetoric:
Al-majāz al-mursal (unrestricted figurative usage): in His saying, the Exalted: «رَبَّنا أَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ».
Because what is meant by the two deaths is: first, their creation as dead, and second, their being put to death at the end of their appointed terms.
And what is meant by the two lives is: the first giving of life, and the giving of life at the resurrection. He, glory be to Him, made this clear in His saying: «وَكُنْتُمْ أَمْواتاً فَأَحْياكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ». So in calling their creation as dead a "causing to die" there is figurative usage, because it is with regard to what they had been. Al-Zamakhsharī made this clear in the most eloquent way in his delightful passage on this subject, which we quote verbatim for its worth. He said: "If you say: how is it correct to call their creation as dead a causing to die? I say: as it is correct for you to say: Glory be to Him who made small the size of the gnat and made large the size of the elephant; and your saying to the well-digger: narrow the mouth of the well and widen its bottom; and there is no transfer here from small to large, nor the reverse, nor from narrowness to width, nor the reverse; he only intended bringing into being with those attributes. The reason for its correctness is that largeness and smallness are both possible for one and the same made thing, without either being favoured. Likewise narrowness and width. So when the maker chooses one of the two possibilities, while being equally able to do either, he has turned the made thing away from the other possibility, and his turning it away from it is made like moving it from it."

safi-cedvel:13-17.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (لكم) attached to a ḥāl from (رزقا). (من السماء) attached to (ينزّل). (الواو) parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). (ما) negation. (إلّا) for restriction. (من) relative noun in the position of the nominative; agent of يتذكّر.
Clause: «هو الذي ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «يريكم ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (الذي).
And the clause: «ينزّل ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause يريكم.
And the clause: «ما يتذكّر إلّا من ... » has no grammatical position; parenthetical «[Note: or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun of address in (يريكم), or in (لكم).]».
And the clause: «ينيب ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (من).
(14) (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition. (مخلصين) ḥāl, accusative, from the agent of ادعوا. (له) attached to مخلصين. (الدين) direct object of the active participle مخلصين. (الواو) circumstantial. (لو) non-jussive conditional particle.
And the clause: «ادعوا الله ... » in the position of the jussive; apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: "if you want Allah's good pleasure, then call upon Him sincerely."
And the clause: «كره الكافرون ... » in the position of the accusative; ḥāl.. and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.
(15) (رفيع) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو", that is, Allah. (ذو) second khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw. (من أمره) attached to a ḥāl from الروح «[Note: or attached to (يلقي), with من denoting causation.]». (على من) attached to (يلقي). (من عباده) attached to a ḥāl from the omitted returning pronoun. (اللام) of causation. (ينذر) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; the first direct object is omitted, i.e. "the people". (يوم) second direct object, accusative, with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "the severity of the Day of Meeting" or "the terrors of the Day of Meeting". (التلاق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the implied kasra on the omitted yāʾ.
And the interpreted maṣdar: «أن ينذر ... » is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (يلقي).
And the clause: «هو رفيع ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «يلقي ... » in the position of the nominative; third khabar of the omitted mubtadaʾ.
And the clause: «يشاء ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (من).
And the clause: «ينذر ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
(16) (يوم) the second, a badal for يوم التلاق, accusative. (لا) negation. (على الله) attached to (يخفى). (منهم) attached to a ḥāl from شيء. (لمن) attached to an omitted fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ الملك. (اليوم) attached to the maṣdar الملك. (لله) attached to the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being الملك.
And the clause: «هم بارزون..» in the position of the genitive; muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «لا يخفى ... شيء» in the position of the nominative; second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم) «[Note: or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun in (بارزون).]».
And the clause: «لمن الملك ... » in the position of the accusative; maqūl al-qawl of an implied saying, i.e. "Allah says: To whom belongs the dominion ..."
And the clause: « (الملك) لله» in the position of the accusative; maqūl al-qawl of another implied saying,
i.e. "Allah says, answering Himself: The dominion belongs to Allah.." The implied saying clause is an explanatory resumption.
(17) (اليوم) adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تجزى). (كلّ) deputy agent, nominative. (ما) a maṣdar particle «[Note: or a relative noun in the position of the genitive ... the returning pronoun being omitted, i.e. "what it earned".]».
And the interpreted maṣdar (ما كسبت..) is in the position of the genitive by (الباء), attached to (تجزى), and (الباء) is causal.
(لا) of generic negation. (اليوم) adverb of time, accusative, attached to the khabar of لا..
And the clause: «تجزى كلّ نفس ... » has no grammatical position; a resumption within the scope of the implied saying.
And the clause: «كسبت ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
And the clause: «لا ظلم اليوم..» has no grammatical position; another resumption within the scope of the saying.
And the clause: «إنّ الله سريع..» has no grammatical position; causal.

* Morphology:
(15) رفيع: an assimilated adjective from the triliteral رفع of the bāb of كرم, i.e. "his rank was high"; its wazn is فعيل.. It may also be an intensive form of the active participle on فعيل from رفع يرفع of the bāb of فتح, i.e. "one who raises the ranks of the believers greatly"..
(التلاق): its origin is التلاقي, a qiyāsī (regular) maṣdar of the quinary verb تلاقى; by rule the letter before the last should have ḍamma, but it received kasra to suit the yāʾ, after the alif returned to its origin, the yāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
Al-majāz al-mursal: in His saying, the Exalted: «وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّماءِ رِزْقاً».
That is, rain; and provision is caused by rain, so the relation in this majāz is causal (musabbabiyya).
- And in His saying, the Exalted: «يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ».
What is meant by الروح is revelation; revelation was called "spirit" because it runs through hearts as spirits run through bodies. So it is a majāz mursal whose relation is causality, and al-Zamakhsharī made it an explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya).

* Benefits:
- The difference between the assimilated adjective and the active participle:
In this verse occurs His saying, the Exalted: «رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجاتِ», and (رفيع) is an assimilated adjective. Perhaps by clarifying the difference between the assimilated adjective and the active participle we can see the meaning of each:
1- The active participle is formed from both transitive and intransitive verbs, such as ضارب, قائم, مستخرج and مستكبر.
The assimilated adjective is formed only from intransitive verbs, such as حسن and جميل.
2- The active participle can be for the three times, while the assimilated adjective is only for the present, that is, the past connected to the present time.
3- The accusative object of the active participle may be fronted before it, as in "زيد عمرا ضارب", whereas "زيد وجهه حسن" is not permitted.
4- Its object (maʿmūl) may be a connected one (sababī) or a foreign one, as in "زيد ضارب غلامه وعمرا"; the maʿmūl of the assimilated adjective is only a connected one; you say "زيد حسن وجهه" or (الوجه). And "زيد حسن عمرا" is excluded.
5- It does not differ from its verb in operation, whereas the assimilated adjective does differ: it governs the accusative although its verb is intransitive; you say "زيد حسن وجهه", and "زيد حسن وجهه" with the accusative is excluded.
[Translator's note: the source text as written gives the same example for the permitted and the excluded form, apparently distinguished only by vowelling lost in transmission.]
6- It may be omitted while its object remains, and for this reason they permitted "أنا زيدا ضاربه" and "هذا ضارب زيد وعمرا", with زيد in the genitive and عمرو in the accusative, by implying a verb or a tanwīn-bearing adjective.
But "مررت برجل حسن الوجه والفعل", with الوجه in the genitive and الفعل in the accusative, is not permitted.
7- It may be separated from its nominative and its accusative, as in "زيد ضارب في الدار أبوه عمرا", and according to the majority "زيد حسن في الحرب وجهه" is excluded, whether you put it in the nominative or the accusative-
[Translator's note: the source text breaks off here with a dash.]

safi-cedvel:18-20.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (يوم) second direct object, accusative. (إذ) adverb in the position of the accusative, a badal for يوم. (لدى) indeclinable adverb in the position of the accusative, attached to an omitted element, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ القلوب. (كاظمين) ḥāl from القلوب «[Note: pluralised with yāʾ and nūn, treating them as the owners of the hearts.]». (ما) negation, inoperative. (للظالمين) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (حميم), which is genitive in form and nominative in position. (الواو) conjunction. (لا) redundant, for emphasis of the negation. (شفيع) conjoined to حميم in form; and the agent of (يعلم) is a latent pronoun referring to Allah. (ما) relative noun in the position of the accusative, conjoined to خائنة.
Clause: «أنذرهم..» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «القلوب لدى الحناجر ... » in the position of the genitive; muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «ما للظالمين من حميم ... » in the position of the accusative; ḥāl from يوم الآزفة, the connector being implied, i.e. "in it" «[Note: or it has no grammatical position, as an explanatory resumption.]».
And the clause: «يطاع ... » in the position of the genitive, or nominative; adjective of شفيع.
And the clause: «يعلم ... » has no grammatical position; causal.
And the clause: «تخفي الصدور..» has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (ما).
(20) (الواو) resumptive. (بالحقّ) attached to (يقضي). (الواو) conjunction. (من دونه) attached to a ḥāl from the omitted returning pronoun, i.e. "they call upon them besides Him". (لا) negation. (بشيء) attached to (يقضون). (هو) pronoun of separation «[Note: or a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ, its khabar being السميع, the nominal clause هو السميع being the khabar of إنّ.]».
And the clause: «الله يقضي ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «يقضي بالحقّ ... » in the position of the nominative; khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
And the clause: «الذين يدعون ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause الله يقضي ...
And the clause: «الذين يدعون ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause: «لا يقضون..» in the position of the nominative; khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
And the clause: «إنّ الله.. السميع» has no grammatical position; causal.

* Morphology:
(18) الآزفة: feminine of الآزف, active participle from (أزف) of the bāb of فرح, i.e. "it drew near"; its wazn is فاعلة. الآزفة in the verse is an adjective of an omitted modified noun, i.e. "the impending Resurrection".
(20) يقضون: it contains an ʿilāl by deletion; its origin is يقضيون with ḍamma on the yāʾ, whose vowel was moved to the ḍād and then it was dropped because two sākin letters met.

* Rhetoric:
1- Kināya (metonymy): in His saying, the Exalted: «إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَناجِرِ كاظِمِينَ».
The expression is a kināya for intensity of fear or excess of pain.
2- Metaphor (istiʿāra): in His saying, the Exalted: «يَعْلَمُ خائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ».
That is, the treacherous glance, such as looking at one who is not a mahram and stealing glances at her, and the like. Making the glance "treacherous" is a figurative attribution (isnād majāzī), or an explicit metaphor, or an implicit and imaginative one (makniyya and takhyīliyya) by making the glance like something stolen from the one looked at.

safi-cedvel:21-22.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) interrogative, containing the sense of intimidation. (الواو) conjunction. (في الأرض) attached to (يسيروا). (الفاء) conjunction. (ينظروا) jussive imperfect, conjoined to (يسيروا) «[Note: it is permissible that it be accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ, the (الفاء) being causal, preceded by an interrogative.]». (كيف) interrogative noun in the position of the accusative; khabar of كان. (من قبلهم) attached to an omitted element, the ṣila of the relative الذين. (هم) pronoun of separation «[Note: the pronoun of separation occurs only between two definites; here it occurs between a definite and an indefinite, but the indefinite resembles the definite because al cannot enter it, since the elative here is followed by the preposition (من).]». (قوّة) tamyīz, accusative. (في الأرض) attached to an adjective of (آثارا). (الفاء) conjunction. (بذنوبهم) attached to a ḥāl from the object pronoun. (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negation. (لهم) attached to the khabar of كان. (من الله) attached to واق. (واق) genitive in form and nominative in position, ism of كان, the sign of the genitive being the implied kasra on the yāʾ omitted because of the tanwīn, so it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ).
Clause: «لم يسيروا..» has no grammatical position; conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. "Were they heedless and did not travel?"
And the clause: «ينظروا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause يسيروا.
And the clause: «كان عاقبة ... » in the position of the accusative; direct object of the verb of looking, suspended by the interrogative كيف, with the preposition implied.
And the clause: «كانوا.. أشدّ ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
And the clause: «أخذهم الله..» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause كانوا ...
And the clause: «ما كان لهم من الله من واق» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أخذهم الله.
(22) The reference in (ذلك) is to the seizing. (بالبيّنات) attached to a ḥāl from رسلهم..
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم كانت تأتيهم رسلهم..) is in the position of the genitive by (الباء), attached to an omitted element, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك. (الفاء) conjunction in both places.
And the clause: «ذلك بأنّهم ... » has no grammatical position; causal.
And the clause: «كانت تأتيهم رسلهم ... » in the position of the nominative; khabar of أنّ.
And the clause: «كانت تأتيهم رسلهم ... » in the position of the accusative; khabar of كانت.
And the clause: «كفروا ... » in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause كانت.
And the clause: «أخذهم الله ... » in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause كفروا..
And the clause: «إنّه قويّ ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.

safi-cedvel:53-54.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) is the lām of oath, for an implied oath. (قد) is a particle of confirmation. (الهدى) is a second direct object, accusative, and likewise (الكتاب). (هدى) is an object of purpose (mafʿūl li-ajlihi), accusative [Note: or a maṣdar in the position of ḥāl.]. (لأولي) is attached to ذكرى [Note: or attached to an adjective of ذكرى..].
The clause «آتينا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the response to the implied oath ... and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «أورثنا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause آتينا.

safi-cedvel:55-55.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is the connective of an implied condition. (الواو) is a conjunction in the three places. (لذنبك) is attached to (استغفر). (بحمد) is attached to a ḥāl from the agent of سبّح. (بالعشيّ) is attached to (سبّح).
The clause «اصبر ... » is in the position of jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: "if your people harm you, then be patient as Mūsā was patient ...".
And the clause «إنّ وعد الله حقّ» has no grammatical position; resumptive — or parenthetical.
And the clause «استغفر ... » is conjoined to the clause اصبر.
And the clause «سبّح ... » is conjoined to the clause اصبر.

safi-cedvel:56-56.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ الذين ... أتاهم) its i'rab has been given [Note: in verse (35) of this sūra.]. (إن) is a particle of negation. (في صدورهم) is a fronted khabar for the mubtadaʾ كبر. (إلّا) is a particle of restriction. (ما) is negative, operating as ليس. (بالغيه) is genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of ما. (الفاء) is the connective of an implied condition. (بالله) is attached to (استعذ). (هو) is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, a mubtadaʾ. (البصير) is a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «إنّ الذين يجادلون ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «يجادلون ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause «أتاهم ... » is in the position of genitive, an adjective of سلطان.
And the clause «إن في صدورهم إلّا كبر ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of inna.
And the clause «ما هم ببالغيه ... » is in the position of nominative, an adjective of كبر.
And the clause «استعذ ... » is in the position of jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if they come to you disputing with you, then seek refuge in Allah".
And the clause «إنّه هو السميع ... » has no grammatical position; explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya).

safi-cedvel:57-58.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) is the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ). (من خلق) is attached to أكبر. (الواو) is a conjunction. (لا) is negative.
The clause «خلق السموات ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «لكنّ أكثر الناس لا يعلمون ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive clause.
And the clause «لا يعلمون ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of لكنّ.
(58) (الواو) is a conjunction in the five places. (ما) is negative. (الذين) is a relative noun in the position of nominative, conjoined to البصير «1», and (لا) is redundant (zāʾida), for emphasis of the negation. (المسيء) is conjoined to (الذين) «2». (قليلا) is an absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq) standing in for the maṣdar, so it is its description, its governor being تتذكّرون. (ما) is redundant, for emphasis of fewness..
And the clause «ما يستوي الأعمى ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive clause.
And the clause «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause that is the ṣila of the relative.
And the clause «تتذكّرون» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(المسيء): an active participle from the quadriliteral verb أساء, on the wazn مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn. In the word there is a weakening by sukūn (iʿlāl bi-l-taskīn) beginning from the imperfect: the yāʾ should properly carry a kasra, but it was given sukūn and its vowel was moved to the sīn before it — a weakening by sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- The art of compelling (fann al-iljāʾ): in the words of the Exalted «لَخَلْقُ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِ».
This art is a lofty one among the arts of rhetoric: the speaker takes the initiative against his opponent with something that compels him to acknowledge its truth. By this its connection with what precedes it is sound, for their disputing about the signs of Allah included many matters of wrangling, sophistry, stubbornness and fallacy, at the forefront of which was the denial of resurrection. And that, in reality, is the root of the dispute and its axis around which it turns. So He, Glorified is He, hastened to confront them with what leaves them dumbfounded and cuts off from them the paths of arrogance and obstinacy, namely the creation of the heavens and the earth. They used to admit that Allah is their Creator and that they are a mighty creation; so the creation of people, by comparison, is a trifling thing, and whoever is able to create them despite their greatness is without doubt more able to create weak man, and this is more eloquent than adducing as evidence the creation of the like of him. And the priority in this adducing is established in two degrees: the first is that the one who is able to do the great is more able to do the lowly. The second is that their dispute was about the resurrection, which is repetition, and there is no doubt that the beginning is greater and more dazzling than the repetition.
2- Artistry and style of speech: in the words of the Exalted «وَما يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمى وَالْبَصِيرُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ وَلَا الْمُسِيءُ».
He, Glorified and Exalted, put «الأعمى» first because blindness is in keeping with the negation of knowledge before it, since what came before it was «وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لا يَعْلَمُونَ»; and put «الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا» afterwards for their adjacency to البصير and for their nobility. In the like of this there are ways: that each be placed beside what is suited to it, as here; that what corresponds to the first be put first and what corresponds to the last be put last, as in the words of the Exalted «وَما يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمى وَالْبَصِيرُ وَلَا الظُّلُماتُ وَلَا النُّورُ وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الْحَرُورُ»; and that the two opposites be put last, like the blind and the deaf, and the hearing and the seeing; and all of that belongs to artistry in rhetoric and the styles of speech.
3- Iltifāt (shift of person): in the words of the Exalted «قَلِيلًا ما تَتَذَكَّرُونَ».
The turning from the third person to address, in a setting of rebuke, indicates severe harshness.

* Benefits:
1- (ولكنّ) The meaning of لكنّ: rectification (istidrāk) and emphasis. Rectification, as in: "Khālid is generous but he is a coward"; and emphasis, as in: "If Khalīl had visited me I would have honoured him, but he did not visit me." This is one of the particles that enter the nominal clause, putting the first in the accusative, called its ism, and the second in the nominative, called its khabar. These particles are: «إنّ - أنّ - كأنّ - لكنّ - ليت - لعلّ».
As for (إنّ and أنّ), they are two particles giving emphasis; كأنّ gives comparison; لعلّ is for expectation; and ليت is for wishing.
2- (ل) the lām of commencement is fatḥa-voweled, its meaning is emphasis. It enters only a noun or an imperfect verb, as in: لخلق السموات والأرض, and إنّ ربك ليحكم بينهم.
The entry of the lām of commencement upon an indefinite noun makes it fit to begin with, as in: لرجل قائم; and the lām of commencement also makes the khabar obligatorily postponed, as in: لزيد قائم; and it enters the khabar of inna, as in: إنّ إبراهيم لمجتهد, and it is not permissible for it to enter the khabar of the rest of the sisters of inna, so one does not say: لعل زيدا لقائم.
3- (الّذين) is a relative noun for the masculine plural of rational beings, indeclinable on the fatḥa. It needs a ṣila, a returning pronoun and a grammatical position, and its position is according to its place in the sentence.

safi-cedvel:23-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the lām of oath, for an implied oath. (قد) particle of certainty. (بآياتنا) ḥāl from موسى or from the agent of أرسلنا.
Clause: «أرسلنا....» has no grammatical position; the response to the implied oath; and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position; resumptive.
(24) (إلى فرعون) attached to (أرسلنا). (الفاء) conjunction. (ساحر) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو". (كذّاب) second khabar, nominative.
And the clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause أرسلنا.
And the clause: « (هو) ساحر» in the position of the accusative; maqūl al-qawl.
(25) (الفاء) conjunction. (لمّا) adverb meaning "when", containing the sense of condition, in the position of the accusative, attached to the apodosis قالوا. (بالحقّ) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of جاءهم. (من عندنا) attached to a ḥāl from الحقّ «[Note: or attached to (جاءهم).]». (معه) adverb, accusative, attached to a ḥāl from the agent of آمنوا «[Note: or attached to (آمنوا).]». (الواو) resumptive. (ما) negation, inoperative. (إلّا) for restriction. (في ضلال) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (كيد).
And the clause: «جاءهم بالحقّ ... » in the position of the genitive; muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position; apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «اقتلوا ... » in the position of the accusative; maqūl al-qawl.
And the clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause: «استحيوا ... » in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause اقتلوا.
And the clause: «ما كيد.. إلّا في ضلال» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(24) كذّاب: an intensive form from the triliteral كذب; its wazn is فعّال with fatḥa on the fāʾ and a doubled, fatḥa-vowelled ʿayn.
(25) استحيوا: it contains an ʿilāl by deletion; its imperfect is يستحييون, with two yāʾs; the ḍamma of the second yāʾ was moved to the first to lighten the heaviness, then the second (yāʾ) was dropped because two sākin letters met, so it became يستحيون. When the verb passed to the imperative, the earlier ʿilāl remained.. its wazn is استفعوا.

safi-cedvel:26-26.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (أقتل) jussive imperfect, the response to a request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the agent is "أنا". (الواو) conjunction. (اللام) the lām of command. (أن) a maṣdar particle governing the accusative, in both places. (في الأرض) attached to (يظهر) «[Note: or attached to a ḥāl from الفساد.]».
Clause: «قال فرعون ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «ذروني..» in the position of the accusative; maqūl al-qawl.
And the clause: «أقتل ... » has no grammatical position; apodosis of an implied condition not accompanied by the fāʾ, i.e. "if you leave me" or "if you let me be, I shall kill.."
And the clause: «يدع ... » in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause ذروني.
And the clause: «إنّي أخاف ... » has no grammatical position; causal.
And the clause: «أخاف ... » in the position of the nominative; khabar of إنّ.
And the clause: «يبدّل ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
And the clause: «يظهر ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the second particle-relative (أن).
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن يبدّل ... ) is in the position of the accusative; direct object, its governing verb being أخاف.
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن يظهر ... ) is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the first interpreted maṣdar.

safi-cedvel:27-27.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (بربيّ) attached to (عذت). (من كلّ) attached to (عذت). (لا) negation. (بيوم) attached to (يؤمن).
Clause: «قال موسى ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «إنّي عذت ... » in the position of the accusative; maqūl al-qawl.
And the clause: «عذت ... » in the position of the nominative; khabar of إنّ.
And the clause: «لا يؤمن ... » in the position of the genitive; adjective of كلّ متكبّر.

* Morphology:
(عذت): it contains an ʿilāl by deletion, being a hollow weak verb (muʿtall ajwaf) attached to the agent's tāʾ; two sākin letters met, the ʿayn of the verb and its lām, so its ʿayn was dropped and the first was given ḍamma as an indication of the kind of letter dropped; its wazn is فلت.

safi-cedvel:28-33.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (من آل) attached to a second adjective of رجل. (الهمزة) for rebuking interrogation. (أن) a maṣdar particle governing the accusative.
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن يقول) is in the position of the genitive by an implied lām, attached to (تقتلون).
(الواو) the wāw of ḥāl. (قد) particle of certainty. (بالبيّنات) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of جاء. (من ربّكم) attached to a ḥāl from البيّنات «[Note: or attached to (جاءكم).]». (الواو) conjunction in both places. (يك) defective imperfect, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the sukūn on the nūn, omitted for lightness. (الفاء) connecting the apodosis. (عليه) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ كذبه. (إن يك صادقا) like إن يك كاذبا. (الذي) relative noun in the position of the genitive; muḍāf ilayhi, the returning pronoun being omitted, its implied form being "إيّاه". (لا) negation. (من) relative noun, direct object, in the position of the accusative.
Clause: «قال رجل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause: «يكتم ... » in the position of the nominative; third adjective of رجل «[Note: or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from رجل because it has been qualified.]».
And the clause: «تقتلون ... » in the position of the accusative; maqūl al-qawl.
And the clause: «يقول ... » has no grammatical position; ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
